name: ferret-conversion-work-budgets
instr:
Ferret cannot bound conversion work across direct runtime calls and FQL execution. Add shared, observable budgets for steps, recursion depth, and inspected text bytes so hostile parsing and traversal stop predictably. Apply limits independently per session; keep unbudgeted behavior unchanged.

Limits are nonnegative; zero is unlimited. Reject invalid direct or engine configurations before conversion. Reserve work before performing it, committing shared usage monotonically and atomically during concurrent parsing, traversal, recursion, normalization, and text inspection. Duration, DateTime, epoch DateTime, Int, and Float must reserve each distinct phase exactly once, including text inspection, native scalar identity, recursive traversal, unit inspection, and numeric normalization. Preserve parsing, validation, truncation, aggregation, range, and operational failures. Number preserves native Int and Float identity, delegates other inputs to Float, and does not duplicate delegated charges.

Exhaustion returns `ConversionLimitError` from `github.com/MontFerret/ferret/v2/pkg/runtime`. Its `Error` and `IsConversionLimit` behavior identifies the limit, target, committed usage, and maximum without reclassifying source failures. `ConversionBudget`, `NewConversionBudget`, `Snapshot`, `WithConversionBudget`, and `ConversionBudgetFromContext` provide deterministic shared accounting and context propagation there. `values.ToIntWithContext` and `values.ToFloatWithContext` from `github.com/M
